notes.title: Disaster Blaster 1.2.0 is here – Now with Streamer Mode & Linux Support!
notes.content:
Hey disaster makers!

We’re beyond excited to drop our biggest update yet — Disaster Blaster 1.2.0 is live! This patch brings major new features, visual upgrades, and a whole new way to experience chaos with your community. Let’s break it down:

[h2]Now on Linux![/h2]
Disaster Blaster is now fully playable on Linux. The Age of the Penguin has begun. 🔫🐧 

[h2]Introducing Streamer Mode (Beta)[/h2]
Ever wanted to suffer for content? Now’s your chance.

Streamer Mode is a brand-new game mode that lets you connect Disaster Blaster directly to your livestream. Your audience becomes an active part of the mayhem — spawning enemies, sabotaging your blaster, and influencing the outcome in wildly unpredictable ways.

Streamer Mode supports both Twitch and TikTok Live. Here’s how it works:

[h3]Real-time chat interaction
[/h3]Viewers spawn enemies named after themselves just by chatting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/a0330b5729debf77017701e29fa48909067a11a2.jpg[/img]

[h3]The sabotage mini-game
[/h3]A chaotic mini-game lets viewers try to destroy your cards during each run.

[olist]
[*][b]Voting phase[/b]: Viewers vote to destroy a card by typing a number (1–6) matching its position in your blaster.
[*][b]Dice roll:[/b] Before your upgrade phase, you roll a die on-screen.
[*][b]Luck vs chat[/b]: If the rolled number matches the top-voted card... it's gone. Bye-bye, upgrade!
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/e20269bd52b6de04c888611d58d86f8503753dd0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/8fc8444946468701e1aa4a7f03ab1548ef414595.jpg[/img]

Turns out, people really enjoy watching you suffer. 😉

[h2]UI glow-up
[/h2]We’ve revamped the look and feel of the game’s interface for a sleeker, more polished experience. It's still chaos, but it looks better now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/aa9e0f8538bc245d77ec1f66f39c16d6498b89fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay & visual improvements
[/h2][list]
[*]Enemies under mind control no longer take friendly fire damage.
[*]Improved visual effects.
[*]Minor bugs have been fixed to keep things running smoothly.
[/list]

[h2]Special launch discount![/h2]
To celebrate this huge milestone, we're running an exclusive discount for a limited time. If you haven't blasted yet, now’s the perfect time to join the madness.

Thanks for all your support, feedback, and hilarious clips. We can't wait to see what chaos you'll unleash in 1.2.0!

Daniele, Caterina and Simone

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Disaster Blaster is OUT NOW! 💥
notes.content:
Ready to build your own weapon of mass destruction? 

Disaster Blaster is an innovative [b]roguelite bullet heaven card game[/b], where you step into the lab-coat of a questionably sane scientist, building the most over-the-top, over-engineered, and definitely unsafe weapon in the universe by assembling and optimizing a sequence of cards. Each run presents a fresh opportunity to test devastating combos against relentless alien hordes across a galaxy of increasingly unfortunate planets!

[previewyoutube=eTzyNFoRu7Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] [b]Unique building system[/b] - add, remove, or reposition cards in your blaster’s sequence. Order matters! Different setups lead to different results.

[*] [b]Absurdly fun combos[/b] - fire bullets that break the laws of physics, explode, electrify, and even mind-control enemies!

[*] [b]Destroy everything[/b] - obliterate not just enemies, but the entire environment. Nothing is safe!

[*] [b]Fast-paced, strategic gameplay[/b] - each run is a thrilling 10-minute session packed with choices and explosions.

[*] [b]Discover new planets & alien species[/b] - encounter bizarre creatures with unique mechanics and unlock them as playable characters.

[*] [b]Unlock dozens of new cards[/b] - expand your arsenal and create even wilder builds!
[/list]

Join the gang of Disaster Makers and start building your ultimate weapon today! 🚀

[h3]Join the community[/h3]
We'd love to hear your thoughts and see your craziest combos! [b]Join our Discord, follow us on socials[/b], and use #DisasterBlasterGame to share your progress!

[h3]Limited-time launch discount![/h3] 
For a limited time, enjoy [b]15% off[/b] Disaster Blaster's launch price! Don't miss out on this explosive deal - grab your copy now and get ready for 10 minutes of pure chaos every time! 💥

[b]A huge thank you to all who supported us![/b]

We want to express our deepest gratitude to everyone who believed in Disaster Blaster and to the people who supported us during this journey. This game would not be what it is today without your incredible support. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! ❤️‍🔥

Daniele, Caterina and Simone

notes.title: Hello everyone, welcome to the Disaster! 👽💥
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 👋
and welcome to the world of Disaster Blaster, the arcade-style roguelite card game where you step into the shoes of a mad scientist with one goal: to build the most devastating weapon in the galaxy. 

Wait, a card game? Yep, you heard that right! At first glance, it might look like a side-scrolling action shooter, but in Disaster Blaster, every round revolves around crafting your weapon from scratch using cards. 

The goal? To obliterate waves of enemies and conquer every planet in the galaxy.

[previewyoutube=6dDz9x3xkpI;full][/previewyoutube]

As you assemble your blaster, a quirky little alien will automatically test it out for you on virtual space expeditions, battling against enemy civilizations trying to stop its progress. Meanwhile, your job is to keep fine-tuning your blaster by adding new cards, swapping the positions of existing ones, or healing your alien companion if it gets into trouble.

Disaster Blaster is still in development, and a lot has changed since we first launched our Steam page. We’ve been working on improving the visual style to make things more exciting and give players a clearer sense of what to expect. In the meantime, we’re adding new cards, worlds, and civilizations that you’ll be able to unlock in the full game. We plan to post regular development updates here, so follow us if you're curious about the progress! 

But most importantly, the [b]Disaster Blaster demo is coming soon[/b]! Yep, it’s just a matter of days (or even hours), so stay tuned for more news very soon!
Here’s a link to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3194600/discussions/0/4700161008288844006/]FAQs[/url], but don’t hesitate to jump into the discussions section if you have any questions or just want to say hi!

Before we sign off, some quick intros: we’re [b]Jarsick[/b], a small three-person team, and we hope to have you on board for this journey with us. 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203994/34635cfedfebe4a22d554269100e3a8ff48c54ba.png[/img]

Thanks for stopping by, and we hope to see you again soon! 🙌💜👋

Best,
Daniele, Caterina, and Simone

notes.title: Disaster Blaster demo coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce that the Disaster Blaster demo will be available on Steam starting in October!  🎮 

This demo will give you a preview of the chaos you can unleash in the full game. You'll have access to a planet and our humanoid alien, Neil<A.>, to play with, along with a basic set of cards to build your blaster. During the games, you can earn in-game money by converting accumulated points and completing the planet's objectives. With the money earned, you'll be able to unlock unique abilities for Neil<A.> and access a reduced set of additional cards, so you can start exploring the strategic combinations you'll develop in the full game.

We are finalizing the last details and will announce the exact release date as soon as possible. Stay tuned for more updates!

We can't wait to hear your impressions and feedback on the demo!

Thank you for your continuous support and enthusiasm for our project!
